questions.q: What happens with two vehicles with sysid 1 on one network?
options: One "jumping" vehicle, commands go to both
The GCS shows the two vehicles separately
The second vehicle cannot arm at all
The router reassigns one of the sysids itself
questions.explain: Addressing is by sysid: without unique numbers the GCS and the commands mix up the vehicles.

questions.q: Why do you set source_system for a pymavlink supervisor?
options: Otherwise it gets no telemetry
pymavlink sends no commands without it
By default it is 255, like the GCS
mavlink-router requires it
questions.explain: Two participants with sysid 255 confuse the failsafe and the routing.

A command to all vehicles
A command to the last vehicle
A packet with no addressee is dropped
questions.explain: Broadcast: yes for a common stop, no as a default.

questions.q: Closing speed 20 m/s, delays 1 s, braking 1.5 s. Roughly how far is covered before stopping?
options: 5 m
questions.explain: 20 m/s × 2.5 s ≈ 50 m; add the position errors, and the trigger threshold is about 60 m.

questions.q: What is the danger of a shared RTL for several vehicles?
options: It does not work in a fleet at all
Draining every vehicle's battery at once
Converging over home at the same altitude
Resetting the sysid after landing
questions.explain: Separate RTL_ALT_M and rally points, and land one at a time.

questions.q: What does FOLL_DIST_MAX do in FOLLOW mode?
options: Beyond it, the follower stops following
Sets the follower's offset from the leader
Limits the follower's flight altitude
Sets the speed for catching up with the leader
questions.explain: If the leader is farther than FOLL_DIST_MAX, the follower holds position.

questions.q: Why do altitude layers not solve everything?
options: Everyone's altitude is equally accurate
Layers are prohibited by flight rules
ArduPilot cannot hold altitude
Takeoff and landing cross the layers
questions.explain: Changing altitude crosses other vehicles' layers, so takeoff and landing are separated in time.

questions.q: Why does a vehicle in a fleet need MAV_GCS_SYSID?
options: To choose the telemetry rate
So another station's heartbeat does not keep the link
To enable FOLLOW mode
To set the router's number
questions.explain: The link-loss failsafe must watch its own GCS, not just any GCS.
